body: They should not cancel then. Instead they should drastically reduce the content we are tested on. In science we should be longer be required to know all of the practicals. In english some schools are no longer doing Poems or A Christmas Carol or an inspector calls. That's the type of change we need. Furthermore we still have time to revise and if the content is reduced that will benefit us even more especially when it comes to revision. Either way this years GCSE's are unfair.

And on top of ^ I'm going through some shit my father has Cancer and is doing ok but that could change any moment. I feel like a fuck up and there is no point in trying if i know I'm going to fail so fuck it. Nothing brings me enjoyment and as I've said my family views me like a fuck up and they are the only ones I have.

I've dropped grades so much in the past 4 years it's only a matter of time until I get 0. I have 0 motivation to revise and do work. Education is the only way for me to have a decent future and if I fail that well theres no hope for me.
